# Character image sources

© SHIFT UP / Proxima Beta. Character artwork and associated marks belong to their respective rights holders.

All 127 original images were retrieved from the official NIKKE popularity-vote site or publisher character-announcement materials. These files are byte-for-byte copies of the retrieved originals. The calculator shows a face region with CSS; no redrawing, raster cropping, or recompression is applied.

`IMAGE-SOURCES.json` contains each character's exact source page, original image URL, dimensions, SHA-256 hash, and display-framing review status. Image availability does not constitute a license determination.

`portraits.js` is keyed by permanent character ID, independent of roster ordering. Unlisted future/custom characters must use a named fallback. Paths are relative to the app root and work under a GitHub Pages project path.

2026-10-29 update: Guilty: Mighty Bunny and Sin: Swift Bunny use the official Level Infinite COIN RUSH SHOWDOWN release; Belorta: Pumpkin Witch uses LITTLE WITCH TRICK. The retrieved publisher CDN bytes are preserved, with CSS-only face framing. Exact URLs and hashes are in the JSON manifest.

2026-10-29 correction: Neon: Vision Eye now uses the standing pose in the official April 30 pickup announcement (PR TIMES release 145037/120), replacing the firing-pose promotional image. Only the CSS face framing is cropped; the retrieved original bytes are unchanged.
